name: Furano (Japan, town)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Furano town emblem in black: an outlined chrysanthemum-like flower of many petals enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Furano in Hokkaido, dissolved on 1966-05-01.

features.role: Furano town emblem — an outlined chrysanthemum-like flower of many petals enclosing a ring with a stylised character
